scope: Proposition 10.7 (The localized stopped four-change test) of the manuscript “Self-dual random-cluster interfaces below one” (preprints/Self-dual-random-cluster-interfaces-below-one-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 223 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 bf15a86507a10184), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 179. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix q ∈ (0, 1) and r0, s0, M > 0. Let Hδ(r0, s0, M, q) consist of the following data: a rounded four-open-change experiment from Lemma 10.5 at mesh δ with V ⊂ B(0, M); a compatible history ω of its strand at a path-adapted stopping time τ, from the original first mark, before completion and revealing only encountered switches; and a point z such that B(z, r0) ⊂ U, where U is the remaining slit disk. Require the tip and the three remaining marked prime ends to have pairwise Euclidean distance at least s0 in a disk chart φU : U → D with φU (z) = 0. The condition is independent of the chart’s rotation. If E is the tested-color pairing alternative and χU is the current ordered cross-ratio, then εstop(δ; r0, s0, M, q) := sup Hδ(r0,s0,M,q) |Popen(E | Fτ )(ω) − f(χU (ω))| −→ 0 (δ ↓ 0). (10.5) An empty supremum is zero. The class includes stops inside local pieces.
